scripts.build:app:fast: npm run prepare:workspace && npm run build:app
scripts.dev: npm run prepare:workspace && npm run dev:raw
scripts.build: npm run prepare:workspace && npm run build:app
scripts.typecheck: npm run prepare:workspace && npm run typecheck:local
scripts.test:unit:fast: npm run prepare:workspace && npm run typecheck:local && npm run test:unit:raw
scripts.test:unit: npm run prepare:workspace && npm run typecheck:local && npm run test:unit:raw
scripts.test:e2e: npm run prepare:e2e && FROSTR_TEST_PREPARED=1 npm run test:e2e:raw
scripts.test:ci: npm run prepare:e2e && FROSTR_TEST_PREPARED=1 npm run typecheck:local && npm run test:unit:raw && npm run test:e2e:raw && npm run build:app
scripts.release:candidate: npm run prepare:e2e && FROSTR_TEST_PREPARED=1 npm run typecheck:local && npm run build:app && npm run test:unit:raw && npm run test:e2e:raw && npm run package
